content.overview: A document may be served on a company or an officer thereof by sending it to the company or officer at the registered office by registered post, speed post, courier, or by leaving it at the registered office, or by such electronic or other mode as may be prescribed. A document may be served on the Registrar or any member in the prescribed manner.
content.glance: Service on company/officer at registered office by permitted modes; electronic mode as prescribed.
content.study: Section 20 sets the modes for serving documents on a company, its officer, the Registrar and members. Service on a company or officer may be by registered post, speed post, courier, leaving at the registered office, or prescribed electronic or other mode.

sections.heading: Service on company or officer
sections.body: Registered post, speed post, courier, leaving at registered office, or prescribed electronic/other mode.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should Section 20 be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the recipient. II. Apply the permitted mode of service. III. Conclude.

enhancement.definition: Section 20 sets modes of service of documents on a company, officer, Registrar and members.
enhancement.legalPrinciple: Service on company/officer at registered office by permitted modes; electronic mode as prescribed.
